name: B47ANCED PC Framework

features.text: Standalone Windows 93 desktop, trusted Lua app registry, powered-device checks and reusable server-owned media bindings.
Runs without Quartermaster; hosts its registered ledger/CD Writer app through callback contracts.
All powered vanilla PC orientations and other placed Computer-tagged tiles; access, electricity and server authority checks retained.
Original bulky CRT/pixel art, retained drive/tool/media-app tasks, minimize/restore, Show Desktop, per-panel close and application resume callbacks; API 1 preserved.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED. G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. No Workshop item assigned. Apps retain gameplay authority and persistence.
